summary: Combinatorial indexing for joint chromatin accessibility and transcriptome from the same cells.

name: sci-fate
title: Sci-fate characterizes the dynamics of gene expression in single cells
summary: Combinatorial-indexing single-cell RNA-seq combined with 4-thiouridine labeling to profile whole and newly synthesized transcriptomes in many cells.

name: sci-Hi-C
title: Massively multiplex single-cell Hi-C
summary: Single-cell Hi-C scaled to thousands of cells by combinatorial cellular indexing.

name: sci-Plex
title: Massively multiplex chemical transcriptomics at single-cell resolution
summary: Nuclear hashing of sci-RNA-seq libraries to multiplex thousands of chemical perturbations in one single-cell experiment.

name: sci-RNA-seq
children: cotech; gage-seq; m3-seq; paired-seq; petri-seq; sci-car; sci-fate; sci-rna-seq3; scifi-rna-seq
title: Comprehensive single-cell transcriptional profiling of a multicellular organism
summary: Single-cell transcriptomes by combinatorial cellular indexing, no physical isolation of cells.

name: sci-RNA-seq3
title: The single-cell transcriptional landscape of mammalian organogenesis
summary: Three-level combinatorial indexing (RT, ligation, PCR) scaling sci-RNA-seq to millions of cells.

name: scifi-ATAC-seq
title: scifi-ATAC-seq: massive-scale single-cell chromatin accessibility sequencing using combinatorial fluidic indexing
summary: Barcoded Tn5 pre-indexing of nuclei before 10x droplet capture, multiplying scATAC throughput about 20-fold.

name: scifi-RNA-seq
title: Ultra-high-throughput single-cell RNA sequencing and perturbation screening with combinatorial fluidic indexing
summary: Combinatorial preindexing of permeabilized cells before droplet scRNA-seq, so several cells per droplet are demultiplexed computationally.

name: sciPlex-ATAC-seq
title: High-capacity sample multiplexing for single cell chromatin accessibility profiling
summary: Combinatorial-indexing scATAC-seq in which unmodified DNA oligo hashes label each sample's nuclei, allowing many specimens to be pooled in one run.

name: SCITO-seq
title: SCITO-seq: single-cell combinatorial indexed cytometry sequencing
summary: Splint-oligo combinatorial indexing of DNA-barcoded antibodies on commercial microfluidics, giving high-throughput protein profiles and optional transcriptome co-profiling.

name: scMNase-seq
title: Genome-wide profiling of nucleosome position and chromatin accessibility in single cells using scMNase-seq
summary: MNase digests FACS-sorted single cells; sub-nucleosome fragments report accessibility and mononucleosome fragments report nucleosome positions.

name: scMT-seq
title: Simultaneous profiling of transcriptome and DNA methylome from a single cell
summary: The cytoplasm is separated from the nucleus; Smart-seq2 profiles RNA and bisulfite-based scRRBS profiles methylation from one cell.

name: scNanoHi-C
title: scNanoHi-C: a single-cell long-read concatemer sequencing method to reveal high-order chromatin structures within individual cells
summary: Single-cell Hi-C read on nanopore so whole ligation concatemers (multi-way contacts) are sequenced.

name: scNMT-seq
title: scNMT-seq enables joint profiling of chromatin accessibility DNA methylation and transcription in single cells
summary: A GpC methyltransferase marks open chromatin before bisulfite conversion, and RNA is split off, giving accessibility, methylation and transcriptome from one cell.

name: scNOMe-seq
title: Simultaneous measurement of chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, and nucleosome phasing in single cells
summary: NOMe-seq adapted to single cells: a GpC methyltransferase marks accessible DNA, and bisulfite sequencing reads accessibility and methylation together.

name: scNT-seq
title: Massively parallel and time-resolved RNA sequencing in single cells with scNT-seq
summary: Droplet-based single-cell RNA-seq that chemically marks newly transcribed mRNA with T-to-C substitutions on barcoded beads to profile new and old transcriptomes together.

name: scONE-seq
title: scONE-seq: A single-cell multi-omics method enables simultaneous dissection of phenotype and genotype heterogeneity from frozen tumors
summary: One-tube single-cell whole-genome DNA and RNA amplification that works on frozen tumour samples.

name: SCRB-seq
title: Characterization of directed differentiation by high-throughput single-cell RNA-Seq
summary: Plate-based digital gene-expression scRNA-seq protocol that surveys mRNA from thousands of single cells.

name: scRCAT-seq
title: Single-cell RNA cap and tail sequencing (scRCAT-seq) reveals subtype-specific isoforms differing in transcript demarcation
summary: Short-read single-cell method that tags both transcript ends during a modified Smart-seq2 protocol, then tagments and captures the 5' or 3' ends to demarcate isoform boundaries.

name: scRRBS
title: Single-cell methylome landscapes of mouse embryonic stem cells and early embryos analyzed using reduced representation bisulfite sequencing
summary: Reduced representation bisulfite sequencing applied to single cells, enriching CpG-rich regions for a single-cell methylome.

name: scSLAM-seq
title: scSLAM-seq reveals core features of transcription dynamics in single cells
summary: Single-cell SLAM-seq that uses thiol alkylation of 4sU-labeled RNA to separate new from old transcripts in each cell.

name: scSPLAT
title: scSPLAT, a scalable plate-based protocol for single cell WGBS library preparation
summary: Plate-based, pooled single-cell whole-genome bisulfite library preparation using splinted ligation adapter tagging.

name: scSPRITE
title: Single-cell measurement of higher-order 3D genome organization with scSPRITE
summary: Split-pool barcoding of crosslinked DNA within single nuclei to map multiway 3D genome contacts.

name: scTAPS
title: Direct and bisulfite-free 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine sequencing at single-cell resolution with scTAPS and scCAPS +
summary: Bisulfite-free, plate-based single-cell sequencing of 5mC and 5hmC at single-base resolution using enzymatic conversion.

name: scTEM-seq
title: scTEM-seq: Single-cell analysis of transposable element methylation to link global epigenetic heterogeneity with transcriptional programs
summary: Single-cell amplicon bisulfite sequencing of SINE Alu elements to estimate global methylation, paired with the transcriptome of the same cell.

name: scTHS-seq
title: Integrative single-cell analysis of transcriptional and epigenetic states in the human adult brain
summary: Transposome hypersensitive-site profiling of single nuclei, run at high throughput alongside droplet snDrop-seq.

name: scTrio-seq
title: Single-cell triple omics sequencing reveals genetic, epigenetic, and transcriptomic heterogeneity in hepatocellular carcinomas
summary: Separates each cell's RNA from its nuclear DNA so copy number, DNA methylome and transcriptome come from one cell.

name: SEC-seq
title: Associating growth factor secretions and transcriptomes of single cells in nanovials using SEC-seq
summary: Hydrogel nanovials capture single cells with their secreted protein, which is tagged and linked to the cell transcriptome.

name: Seq-Well
title: Seq-Well: portable, low-cost RNA sequencing of single cells at high throughput
summary: Portable scRNA-seq where barcoded capture beads and single cells are sealed in subnanoliter wells under a semipermeable membrane.

name: Seq-Well S3
title: Second-Strand Synthesis-Based Massively Parallel scRNA-Seq Reveals Cellular States and Molecular Features of Human Inflammatory Skin Pathologies
summary: Seq-Well variant that uses randomly primed second-strand synthesis to recover cDNA that failed template switching, improving per-cell fidelity.

name: SeqTag
title: The molecular asynchrony of single cells
summary: Single-cell multiomics: antibody-targeted CUT&Tag (histone marks) + ATAC (accessibility) + RNA from the same cell, with plate-based combinatorial barcoding. Named in the abstract only, not the title.

name: SHARE-seq
title: Chromatin Potential Identified by Shared Single-Cell Profiling of RNA and Chromatin
summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding of accessibility and transcriptome from the same single cells.

name: SIMPLE-seq
title: Simultaneous single-cell analysis of 5mC and 5hmC with SIMPLE-seq
summary: Single-cell method that jointly maps 5mC and 5hmC at base resolution by labeling each modification and recording it as C-to-T signals.

name: single-cell Hi-C
title: Single-cell Hi-C reveals cell-to-cell variability in chromosome structure
summary: Hi-C performed in individually isolated nuclei to measure contacts in single cells.

name: single-cell RNA-seq
children: astar-seq; cel-seq; chair; direct-seq; drop-seq; eccite-seq; hires; live-seq; matq-seq; nasc-seq; probac-seq; sc-end5-seq; sceu-seq; sci-rna-seq; scnt-seq; scslam-seq; sctem-seq; share-seq; snaptotal-seq; snmc2t-seq; tea-seq; zipseq
title: mRNA-Seq whole-transcriptome analysis of a single cell
summary: First whole-transcriptome sequencing of a single cell (manually picked cells, plate-based cDNA amplification).

name: SLAM-seq
aliases: thiol(SH)-linked alkylation for metabolic sequencing of RNA
title: Thiol-linked alkylation of RNA to assess expression dynamics
summary: Labels new RNA with 4-thiouridine, then alkylates the s4U so it is read as a T-to-C change in standard RNA-seq, giving transcript-level expression dynamics.

name: Slide-DNA-seq
title: Spatial genomics enables multi-modal study of clonal heterogeneity in tissues
summary: Spatially barcoded DNA capture from tissue sections on bead arrays, used to map clonal copy-number populations in place.

name: Slide-seq
title: Slide-seq: A scalable technology for measuring genome-wide expression at high spatial resolution
summary: RNA from a tissue section is transferred onto DNA-barcoded beads at known positions, giving spatially resolved transcriptomes.

name: Slide-seqV2
title: Highly sensitive spatial transcriptomics at near-cellular resolution with Slide-seqV2
summary: Improved Slide-seq with better library generation, bead synthesis and array indexing for much higher RNA capture efficiency.

name: Slide-tags
title: Slide-tags enables single-nucleus barcoding for multimodal spatial genomics
summary: Nuclei in an intact tissue section are tagged with position barcodes from bead arrays, then profiled with standard single-nucleus assays.

name: SMART-seq
title: Full-length mRNA-Seq from single-cell levels of RNA and individual circulating tumor cells
summary: Template-switching amplification of full-length cDNA from single cells, giving even coverage along transcripts.

name: Smart-seq2
children: g-and-t-seq; limca; sccat-seq; scmt-seq; scnmt-seq; scrcat-seq; sctrio-seq; smart-seq3
title: Smart-seq2 for sensitive full-length transcriptome profiling in single cells
summary: Optimised SMART-seq with improved reverse transcription, template switching and preamplification for higher-yield full-length libraries.

name: Smart-seq3
title: Single-cell RNA counting at allele and isoform resolution using Smart-seq3
summary: Full-length single-cell RNA-seq with a 5' UMI in the template-switching oligo, so molecules can be counted and assigned to alleles and isoforms.

name: Smart-seq3xpress
title: Scalable single-cell RNA sequencing from full transcripts with Smart-seq3xpress
summary: Miniaturised, streamlined Smart-seq3 with lower reagent use for high-throughput full-length single-cell RNA-seq.

name: sn-m3C-seq
title: Simultaneous profiling of 3D genome structure and DNA methylation in single human cells
summary: Joint chromatin conformation and DNA methylome from the same single nucleus via bisulfite conversion of 3C libraries.

name: snapTotal-seq
title: Single-cell total-RNA profiling unveils regulatory hubs of transcription factors
summary: One-step total-RNA single-cell RNA-seq that captures unspliced as well as spliced transcripts, enabling RNA-velocity kinetic analysis.

name: SNARE-seq
title: High-throughput sequencing of the transcriptome and chromatin accessibility in the same cell
summary: Droplet-based joint profiling of accessibility and transcriptome by capturing tagmented DNA alongside mRNA.

name: snATAC-seq
title: Single-nucleus analysis of accessible chromatin in developing mouse forebrain reveals cell-type-specific transcriptional regulation
summary: Combinatorial barcoding of Tn5-tagmented nuclei from flash-frozen tissue, giving single-nucleus chromatin accessibility profiles.

name: snmC-seq
title: Single-cell methylomes identify neuronal subtypes and regulatory elements in mammalian cortex
summary: Single-nucleus methylome sequencing with improved throughput, used to classify neuronal subtypes.

name: snmC2T-seq
title: Single nucleus multi-omics links human cortical cell regulatory genome diversity to disease risk variants
summary: Single-nucleus joint profiling of DNA methylation, chromatin accessibility and transcriptome from the same nucleus.

name: snRandom-seq
title: High-throughput single nucleus total RNA sequencing of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues by snRandom-seq
summary: Droplet-based single-nucleus total RNA sequencing that uses random primers so that non-polyadenylated RNA and FFPE-archived material can be profiled.

name: SNuBar-ATAC
title: Simple oligonucleotide-based multiplexing of single-cell chromatin accessibility
summary: Single-oligo transposome barcoding during tagmentation lets scATAC-seq samples be multiplexed without a pre-labelling step.

name: SPATAC-seq
title: Mapping the chromatin accessibility landscape of zebrafish embryogenesis at single-cell resolution by SPATAC-seq
summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding of Tn5-tagmented chromatin for single-nucleus ATAC profiling at atlas scale.

name: Spatial-ATAC-seq
title: Spatial profiling of chromatin accessibility in mouse and human tissues
summary: Tissue-section chromatin accessibility profiling that combines in situ Tn5 tagmentation with microfluidic deterministic barcoding (DBiT-style).

name: Spatial-CUT&Tag
title: Spatial-CUT&Tag: Spatially resolved chromatin modification profiling at the cellular level
summary: Tissue-section profiling of histone modifications by in situ CUT&Tag chemistry with microfluidic deterministic barcoding.

name: Spear-ATAC
title: High-throughput single-cell chromatin accessibility CRISPR screens enable unbiased identification of regulatory networks in cancer
summary: Droplet scATAC-seq modified to also capture sgRNA spacers, so chromatin accessibility can be read out for each CRISPR perturbation.

name: spinDrop
title: spinDrop: a droplet microfluidic platform to maximise single-cell sequencing information content
summary: Droplet platform that sorts droplets by fluorescence and uses picoinjection to add lysis and reverse transcription reagents, raising gene detection and cutting background.

name: SPLiT-seq
title: Single-cell profiling of the developing mouse brain and spinal cord with split-pool barcoding
summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding labels RNA from fixed cells or nuclei through successive rounds of barcoding, with no single-cell isolation.

name: SPRITE
title: Higher-Order Inter-chromosomal Hubs Shape 3D Genome Organization in the Nucleus
summary: Ligation-free mapping of multi-way interactions by split-pool barcoding of crosslinked complexes.

name: Strand-seq
title: DNA template strand sequencing of single-cells maps genomic rearrangements at high resolution
summary: BrdU-labels one parental DNA strand over a single replication round so each single cell's template strands are sequenced separately, mapping sister chromatid exchanges and inversions.

name: STRT-seq
title: Characterization of the single-cell transcriptional landscape by highly multiplex RNA-seq
summary: Single-cell tagged reverse transcription that barcodes cDNA at the mRNA 5' end, so cells are pooled and sequenced by their 5' ends.

name: STRT-seq-2i
title: STRT-seq-2i: dual-index 5' single cell and nucleus RNA-seq on an addressable microwell array
summary: STRT-seq on an addressable 9600-microwell array, with dual-index barcodes and cell sampling by limiting dilution or FACS.

name: TEA-seq
title: Simultaneous trimodal single-cell measurement of transcripts, epitopes, and chromatin accessibility using TEA-seq
summary: Droplet-based trimodal assay that measures RNA, surface epitopes and chromatin accessibility from the same single cells.

name: Tiled-MCC
title: Analysis of sub-kilobase chromatin topology reveals nano-scale regulatory interactions with variable dependence on cohesin and CTCF
summary: Micro-Capture-C with oligos tiled across a whole region, giving all-vs-all contacts within the captured locus.

name: TIME-seq
title: TIME-seq reduces time and cost of DNA methylation measurement for epigenetic clock construction
summary: Highly multiplexed tagmentation-based targeted methylation sequencing used to build low-cost epigenetic clocks.

name: TimeLapse-seq
title: TimeLapse-seq: adding a temporal dimension to RNA sequencing through nucleoside recoding
summary: Bulk RNA-seq that chemically recodes 4-thiouridine into cytidine analogs so newly transcribed RNA is marked by U-to-C mutations.

name: TimeVault
title: A genetically encoded device for transcriptome storage in mammalian cells
summary: Genetically encoded vault particles capture polyadenylated mRNA inside living cells to store a transcriptome snapshot for later readout.

name: TIP-seq
title: High-throughput single-cell epigenomic profiling by targeted insertion of promoters (TIP-seq)
summary: Antibody-tethered Tn5 inserts a T7 promoter at target sites; in vitro transcription amplifies them linearly for single-cell chromatin profiling.

name: TOPmentation
title: MLL-AF4 cooperates with PAF1 and FACT to drive high-density enhancer interactions in leukemia
summary: Optimised high-throughput ChIPmentation for weakly bound non-histone proteins from ~100,000 cells. Named only in the Results section.

name: Trac-looping
title: Trac-looping measures genome structure and chromatin accessibility
summary: Transposase inserts a bivalent linker between interacting regions, capturing chromatin contacts and accessibility without fragmentation or ligation.

name: txci-ATAC-seq
title: txci-ATAC-seq: a massive-scale single-cell technique to profile chromatin accessibility
summary: Tn5 pre-indexing of nuclei across samples followed by 10x barcoding, scaling scATAC to about 200,000 nuclei per reaction.

name: VASA-seq
title: High-throughput total RNA sequencing in single cells using VASA-seq
summary: Total-RNA single-cell sequencing that fragments and tails all RNA after lysis, so non-polyadenylated and non-coding transcripts are captured.

name: wellDA-seq
title: Single cell genome and epigenome co-profiling reveals hardwiring and plasticity in breast cancer
summary: Dual-Tn5 tagmentation splits open and closed chromatin into ATAC and DNA libraries, with nanowell chip partitioning to co-profile copy number and accessibility in single cells.

name: WGBS
title: Human DNA methylomes at base resolution show widespread epigenomic differences
summary: Bisulfite conversion plus whole-genome sequencing to map DNA methylation at single-base resolution.

name: ZipSeq
title: ZipSeq: barcoding for real-time mapping of single cell transcriptomes
summary: Patterned illumination prints photocaged barcodes ("zipcodes") onto live cells in tissue, linking each transcriptome to its position.
